policy: Only explicit reviewed phrase-to-widget FontObject contracts are checked. Review producer source, callers, template inheritance and later font changes before refreshing sha256. Buttons bind every declared font state. Font objects resolve through the pinned client font mappings; translated text never selects a font. Dynamic game data, tooltips, menus, chat and unlisted or uncertain consumers have no coverage claim. Empty bindings pin reviewed dependencies or exclusions, not glyph coverage.

producers.review: Read Text, Header, StatusBar and ObjectiveBar and their List, Detail, Instances and Window callers. Text creates the requested FontString and changes only colour; Header passes GameFontNormalLarge. No later SetFont or SetFontObject replaces these labels in the reviewed callers. Empty bindings pin these shared helpers, not dynamic game data or template-owned progress text.

Read CreateRow, UpdateRow, SetNew, Create, SetEmptyText, Refresh and Update, plus Window.Refresh calling SetEmptyText. New explicitly inherits GameFontHighlight; Sub and empty use Art.Text with GameFontHighlight. Later updates change text, colour, width and visibility only. Bind the format phrase, not inserted client creature families or levels; species names and tooltip output are excluded.

Read CreateSlot, Create, Show, UpdateResearch, UpdateVariants, SlotStatus, TierName and UpdateRecords, and Window.UpdateDetail. Art.Text establishes each listed font; Art.Header uses GameFontNormalLarge. Subsequent calls change text, colours, geometry or visibility, never font. Read pinned ThreeSliceButtonTemplate.xml: SharedButtonSmallTemplate inherits BigRedThreeSliceButtonTemplate and ThreeSliceButtonTemplate and declares all three bound button states. Read ThreeSliceButtonMixin UpdateButton and UpdateScale; they change art and geometry. Bind addon wording only, excluding inserted creature and zone names, client families, dates and numeric values. Also read UIButtonMixin InitButton, OnEnter, OnLeave and RunCustomTextFormatter: no custom formatter is configured by these callers and no inherited font replacement occurs.

producers.review: Read CreateInstanceRow, CreateBossRow, Create, Group, Subtitle, Draw, Refresh and Breadcrumb and its Window callers. Explicit Art.Text fonts survive later text, colour and visibility updates; Header uses GameFontNormalLarge. Unknown instance can reach both row.Name and Instances.name. Bind static phrases and format wording only, excluding inserted instance and boss names, client levels, dates, encounter records and tooltips. Breadcrumb font is owned by Window and is excluded here.

producers.review: Read MakeButton, BuildSearch, BuildBreadcrumb, BuildBottom, Create, Refresh, UpdateProgress, UpdateFilterButton, UpdateBreadcrumb and SetTab, and List.SetEmptyText. Art.Text fonts are explicit and are not replaced later; search SetFontObject affects user input only. Read pinned ThreeSliceButtonTemplate.xml inheritance and ThreeSliceButtonMixin UpdateButton/UpdateScale: SharedButtonSmallTemplate declares GameFontNormal, GameFontHighlight and GameFontDisable, with art-only state updates. MakeButton changes label colour only. Bind every filter and tracking label state. Native portrait title, side-tab tooltips, menus, user search text and inserted zone/instance names are excluded. List.lua pins the recipient font of SetEmptyText. Also read UIButtonMixin InitButton, OnEnter, OnLeave and RunCustomTextFormatter: no custom formatter is configured by these callers and no inherited font replacement occurs.

producers.review: Read SetArt, SetUp, SpeciesToast, CreateMover, Flush and the queue setup and mover callbacks.
